name: Christopher Creek Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 231896 (193 days observed, edges opens)
note: Tonto NF (Payson RD), 21 mi E of Payson on SR-260 along Christopher Creek. 43 family sites plus a group site on both sides of the creek. Max RV/trailer length 22 ft (borderline for a 23-ft rig). Mostly reservable online, a few FCFS via on-site fee machine; open ~Apr-Nov. --Claude

name: White Horse Lake Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233955 (149 days observed, edges closes)
note: Kaibab NF (Williams RD) on White Horse Lake, ~19 mi SE of Williams at ~6,600 ft. 77 single sites plus 10 doubles, tent-only, accessible and a group site; no hookups, RVs to 45 ft. Reservable online. Potable water is drinking-only (no RV tank filling). Small boat ramp, vault toilets. --Claude

name: Winn Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232204 (142 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF (Springerville RD) SW of Greer in the White Mountains at ~9,300 ft. 63 sites (some RV, some tent-only, 2 group), reservable online, no hookups. Listed RV max is generous but the access road is rough; arrive with full water tanks (potable water fill available at Big Lake ~10 mi). Vault toilets, drinking water; near Mt Baldy Wilderness. Open ~mid-May through October. --Claude

name: Rainbow Campground (Big Lake)
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232200 (149 days observed, edges closes)
note: Apache-Sitgreaves NF (Big Lake Recreation Area), White Mountains ~9,000 ft. Largest Big Lake campground: 165 sites in six loops (incl. double and QUAD/group units). Adjacent to 450-acre Big Lake (top AZ trout fishing). Mostly reservable online, some FCFS booked in person; open ~mid-May to mid-Sep, camp store. --Claude

name: Dairy Springs Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232144 (121 days observed, edges opens)
note: Coconino NF (Mormon Lake RD), in old ponderosa pine/oak forest on the west side of seasonal Mormon Lake ~21 mi SE of Flagstaff via Lake Mary Rd. 30 single sites (plus 2 group). Half the sites reservable on recreation.gov, sites 25-30 first-come first-served. Elevation ~7,200 ft. --Claude

name: Panther Flat Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232322 (336 days observed, edges closes)
note: Largest campground in the Smith River NRA (Six Rivers NF), off US-199 near Gasquet on the Middle Fork Smith River. ~39 sites, RVs/trailers to 40 ft, flush toilets, coin-operated hot showers, drinking water, no hookups. Reservable late spring-early fall. --Claude

name: Minersville Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 233347 (325 days observed, edges closes)
note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground on the Stuart Fork arm of Trinity Lake, ~17 mi N of Weaverville off Hwy 3, beside the Minersville boat ramp. 14 sites - a developed drive-in loop with paved level aprons plus 6 walk-in tent sites; max trailer ~36 ft, vault toilets, no potable water. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Rocky Rest Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234549 (123 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tahoe National Forest campground off Hwy 49 along the North Yuba River near Camptonville, ~10 mi NE of town. 10 sites with picnic tables and fire rings, piped water, vault toilets, no hookups; parking spurs 10-30 ft (most sites take RVs to ~30 ft). North Yuba Trail trailhead in the campground. Seasonal (~late Apr-late Oct), reservable online. --Claude

name: Merrill Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 232902 (147 days observed, edges closes)
note: Large Lassen NF campground on the south shore of Eagle Lake; 172 sites (57 full-hookup, 64 water/electric, 51 no-hookup), spurs 45-75 ft (easily fits a 23-ft rig). 45 walk-in FCFS sites plus reservable sites on Recreation.gov; open ~May-Oct. --Claude

name: Boca Rest Campground
season_source: recreation.gov availability calendar, facility 234115 (105 days observed, edges closes)
note: Tahoe NF campground on the east shore of Boca Reservoir near the Little Truckee River, off Boca Rd near Truckee; 39 standard nonelectric sites (max 1 RV/site), reservable + some FCFS. --Claude
